title: Scheduler could sleep past the pick's first pitch while should_lock stayed False; a restart after the deadline skipped the fallback (4/03–4/06)
missing_evidence: Pi5 scheduler output and scheduler_state.json runs_completed (pick_name/pick_p, since 6d36adb) for 2026-04-03..04-06 (retention unknown; Pi5 decommissioned 4/14) showing a should_lock=False check followed by a sleep past the pick's first pitch, or a restart after the deadline — Phase 2 Route R
the 2026-04-06 pick file's post time (bluesky_uri) versus its game time, and the contest ledger's 4/06 entry (B1/B3)
tier_reason: if it fired, the pick was posted after its first pitch (not enterable) or not at all; no affected date is evidenced

contract.text: If the picked game is 15 minutes from first pitch and the pick is still unlocked, post it anyway ('Don't miss the game').

mechanism.text: run_day had no in-loop fallback: after a should_lock=False check it slept until the next scheduled check, which could fall after the pick's first pitch; the only fallback (step 5) ran after the day's last check
the in-loop fallback added by 0632976 gated both the wait and the post on now < deadline, so a restart or check after the deadline (still pre-game) skipped the post and slept on to the next check

residual.text: the fallback deadline was keyed to the primary pick's game only, so a double-down in an earlier game could still be posted after its first pitch; fixed 4/12 by 6fd61f9 (I-021)

watchdog.trigger: while the candidate is undelivered, the scheduler's next wake-up (sleep target or next_wakeup) is later than the earliest pick game's first pitch minus 5 minutes
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the pick is delivered before that cutoff, or an alert fires at the cutoff

evidence.what: the scheduler 'would sleep past the picked player's game start when should_lock returned False (0% gap) and the next cluster check was hours later'; now wakes at game_time − 15 min to force-post
if the scheduler restarts or checks after the deadline it should post immediately; the previous code (0632976) gated both the sleep and the post on now < deadline
no in-loop fallback before 0632976; its new branch skipped the post once now ≥ deadline
first successful deploy run whose head (4a82cf8) contains both fixes; a Fly.io deploy, log expired

notes: the timing (0632976 at 15:55:46 and a002b04 2.7 min later on a game day) and '(0% gap)' suggest a live case, e.g. a 16:10 game whose 15-minute deadline was 15:55, but neither body says the day's pick was late — hence unresolved
link 2 was introduced by 0632976 and fixed 2.7 minutes later; if 0632976 never ran live before a002b04 it is a pre-ship defect inside this fix (split? link 2 as pre_ship_exclusion)
I-009 (4/04) shows the same exposure: an unlocked pick with no in-loop fallback
